notes.title: 【Craft Hero: Prologue】Updated on May 18 -- More shortcuts coming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993967/7c08be6ea334111182ca6cc10b261a8507356d89.png[/img]

【Craft Hero: Prologue】Updated on May 18

1. Add the right mouse button as the "Return" shortcut
2. A shortcut bar has been added to the game, so you can use props and build buildings more quickly
3. Optimized the sound effect of character movement
4. Added notice after defeating BOSS
5. Adjusted the values ​​in the middle of the game
6. Adjusted the difficulty of the game boss
7. Optimized the art pattern of the mouse pointer

notes.title: Craft Hero: Prologue -- March.14 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993967/30702fcc3c034f1bee4434fe7d9f2876d3728cd4.png[/img]

Hey Heroes, how is your journey in Craft Hero: Prologue?  As your Great Dark Lord, I've made some adjustments in the game:

[olist]
[*] [b]UI Enlarged[/b] [b]UI Enlarged[/b] [b]UI Enlarged[/b], you don't need grandpa's glasses anymore.

[*]  Added hotkey hint to all buttons, now you don't need to wave your mouse around.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993967/d2418e9fc1fae2571ebcd29c2d440a7b0b0103fa.png[/img]

[*] New game will begin in the evening now. This means Mobs are active from the beginning.
I hope this may help get more motivation to start the game off. Let me know what you think!

[*] The shortcut key of [b]fast building[/b] is now [b]R[/b]
Build a thing, then press "R" and then select a direction, that's fast building there.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993967/76ee949b13feecb07a2dee2c8701ace2aff03590.gif[/img]

[*] Fix the issue that the game may crash after equipping specific weapons or runes.
[/olist]

If you encounter a bug, please reply here/ make a post in discussion / reply in Bug thread/ reply in feedback form. All your feedback will be taken into the development of the full game, thank you for your support!

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/EJs67Zqqrt]Discord[/url] to find fellow Heroes!
